about: Known-item queries for lit's search battery. Queries are topic words, not titles. Every target was confirmed on 2026-11-14 through the arXiv API (arxiv ids), the LessWrong search API (lw ids) or the OpenReview search API (openreview ids). Items with heldout=true were set aside before any tuning (every 4th item) and are reported separately.
